// A binding that is ever written from the os module or process.env may be
// read as it: reads before and after the write are refused. A line ending in
// "// flagged" must be reported; every other line must pass.
let os = await import('node:os');
os.homedir(); // flagged
const { homedir: before } = os; // flagged
os = await import('os');
os['homedir'](); // flagged
const { homedir: after } = os; // flagged
let laterOs = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
laterOs.homedir(); // flagged
laterOs = require('node:os');
let laterEnv = { HOME: 'fixture-home' };
laterEnv.HOME; // flagged
laterEnv = process.env;
// A binding never written from either passes.
let fixtureOs = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
fixtureOs = { homedir: () => 'other-home' };
fixtureOs.homedir();
let fixtureEnv = { HOME: 'fixture-home' };
fixtureEnv = { HOME: 'other-home' };
fixtureEnv.HOME;
